$comment: Typography tokens (T016). All three families are self-hosted under packages/design-system/tokens/fonts/, one licence-recorded pack each — the decision, the licence records and the @font-face delivery are in packages/design-system/specs/typography-tokens.md (feature 005 T523); read that file before editing `family` or `face`. The `role` group (T524, FR-007, contracts/token-families.md §4, research D7) is the utility vocabulary a component actually writes: `type-display`, `type-body`, `type-supporting`, `type-numeric`, `type-machine`, `type-identifier`, one meaning per role rather than one shared monospace treatment for three. `numeric` alone carries `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` — declaring it on a role shared with `machine` would apply it to filenames and error classes, where it means nothing. `identifier` alone carries a `color` of `text-secondary`, the one role whose utility sets a property outside typography: a deliberate widening (research D7) so that an unobserved value stays visibly distinct from a measured one even for a caller who reaches for the role without reading contracts/token-families.md §4. `supporting` is one size step down from `body` by the same table; the size is not baked into its utility because sizing is already the `text-*` vocabulary's job and a role must not duplicate it — a caller pairs `type-supporting` with the next size step down. Every `role.<name>.family` names a key in `family` above and is asserted so in build-tokens.test.mjs, the same silent-failure class §4.3 step 6 closed for `face`/`family`. `size`'s `lineHeight` values are re-derived (T524, typography-tokens.md §11 point 5) so every step lands on a real `space.json` `scale` step — a line-height expressible as a whole multiple of `space.unit` (0.25rem) that is also a named rhythm step, not an arbitrary decimal; `lg`, `xl` and `3xl` moved for exactly that reason (1.75rem and 2.25rem are not `space.scale` members). `size.value`s are unchanged: measured against the shipped faces (typography-tokens.md §11 points 1-2 — x-height/cap-height ÷ em for Fraunces against Inter, the real body face, and against Georgia, the fallback it replaces) the display steps in use (`lg` through `3xl`) clear or tie Inter's apparent size at every step actually used for a heading, so no step needed bumping for hierarchy to hold; the full measurement is recorded in the T524 hand-back rather than restated here, because it is a one-time proof, not a living fact this file must keep true. Edit here, then run `pnpm --filter design-system tokens:build`.
